from.place: Native cohomological decomposition of smooth dualizing purity: cohomology

title: The surviving cohomology of the native smooth exceptional constant object
statement: Let k₀ be a finite field and ℓ a prime different from its characteristic. Let a₀ : X₀ → Spec k₀ be separated, finite type, and smooth of relative dimension d ∈ ℕ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. In the native derived category [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], let J be any right adjoint of Ra₀! with adjunction adj. There is an isomorphism of constructible Weil sheaves H^(−2d)(J(ℚ̄_ℓ,Spec k₀[0])) ≅ ℚ̄_ℓ,X₀(d) ⊗ ℚ̄_ℓ,X₀. The constants have the canonical Weil structure [def-weil-constant-weil-structure] and the Tate line has the canonical Frobenius twist [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. The tensor is the native lisse tensor convention. This assertion says nothing about the other cohomology degrees.

source.place: Apply smooth purity to the structure morphism and the constant coefficient object; native exceptional adjunction and canonical Frobenius refinement.

proof.text: Bundle the finite base field and its algebraic closure into D, and use the lifted native coefficient closure as P.Qbar. Regard the structure morphism as a map of arithmetic models. Choose its compactification and an existing coefficient-normalized exceptional adjunction system. Separated finite type and smooth relative dimension persist under geometric base change.

source.place: Structure-morphism and constant-unit specialization; take cohomology of the coefficient purity isomorphism with its canonical Frobenius square.

proof.text: Apply the canonical common-stage smooth purity isomorphism gamma at the coefficient unit. Clause three of the constant-purity Frobenius square is exactly the intertwining equation between the canonical twisted-constant pair T_d and the exceptional constant pair E_S. IsoAlgebra.isoMk therefore makes gamma into an actual isomorphism of Frobenius pairs. This is coefficient_smooth_purity_iso, proved in the item module.

source.place: Structure-morphism and constant-unit specialization; take cohomology of the coefficient purity isomorphism with its canonical Frobenius square.

proof.text: Apply the degree -2d functor from the coefficient cohomology comparison to the inverse of that pair isomorphism. Compose on the left with its exceptional endpoint identification for the given J and adj, and on the right with its canonical Tate endpoint identification. This gives the required native Weil-sheaf isomorphism. No vanishing in other degrees or identification of native derived categories with fixed pairs is used.
